payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate c from n down to 2; for each c, use its binary to count valid a,b pairs by picking a 1-bit index i (after first) and a 0-bit index j>i, computing left/right combinations.
payload.rationale: The algorithm does not perform backtracking or graph search; it enumerates over bit positions and computes products of powers of two, resembling bitmask enumeration.
